answer_2.quote: We use an off-the-shelf stance detector ... and it has an accuracy of 0.97 for LM responses with clear stances.

answer_3.quote: We then use an off-the-shelf stance detector (a BART-based model trained on MultiNLI) to determine whether the generated response agrees or disagrees with the given statement.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on 110 randomly sampled responses and compare the results to those generated by the detector.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label whether each LM-generated response agrees or disagrees with the statement.
